name: Burlington CC (Vermont hardwoods in the fall)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Burlington Country Club, Vermont: a 1924 Donald Ross parkland course on the hill above Lake Champlain, tree-lined by northern hardwoods (sugar and red maple, paper birch) with white pine and hemlock, drawn at Vermont's peak foliage. The turf stays green: fairways and greens as bayside, a deeper, cooler mown parkland rough (F0-F2: no native grass); the woods' floor is maple leaf litter (G0-G2: woods and out-of-bounds woods, warmer and redder than George Wright's russet); white sand; Champlain blue-grey water; grey paths; dark slate roofs. Trees in assets-src/trees_burlington_cc.py. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these. Course chat, 2026-10-30.
